en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town in a river valley. In the foreground there is a weir and a narrow bridge across the river, with multi‑storey industrial and residential buildings lining the banks. One prominent riverside building bears large painted signage, and another long block with many windows stands on the right. Behind the riverside quarter, densely packed houses climb a wooded slope towards a large hilltop castle complex with towers and ornate gables. On the distant right ridge stands a small church with a steeple. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century industrial town dominated by a historic castle.
